record.one_liner: Notion API allows developers to interact with Notion workspaces, pages, and databases using REST endpoints with OAuth 2.0 and bearer token authentication.

auth_methods.quote: Internal connection use a static credential called an internal connection API token, personal access tokens use a user-scoped static token, and OAuth integrations and public integrations use the OAuth 2.0 protocol.

access_test.quote: You can start authorization as soon as you configure the integration’s client credentials and redirect URI; Marketplace submission or review is not required.

access_ship.quote: An OAuth integration can be installed in any Notion workspace within its installation scope — a specific set chosen at creation time for scoped integrations, or any workspace for public integrations.

api_type.quote: The API token will be used to authenticate REST API requests.

api_breadth.quote: Capabilities determine which operations a connection or token can perform, such as reading pages, updating databases, or adding comments.
